heading: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Is everything made fresh?
items.answer: Yes - everything is prepared to order, right in front of you. Nothing is pre-made or stored.

items.question: Do you use any additives?
items.answer: Never. Everything we offer is 100% natural with no added sugar, colours or preservatives.

items.question: Can I book you for a private event?
items.answer: Absolutely. We bring a live counter to weddings, corporate events, festivals and parties. Use the enquiry form to get a quote.

items.question: Do you deliver?
items.answer: Yes, we offer local delivery. Place an order online and choose a slot - it arrives ready to enjoy.

items.question: How do I get in touch about a partnership?
items.answer: Tell us your city and a little about you via the enquiry form. Our team replies within 24 hours with next steps.
